note: Jab (MOVES.md, Seraph): the fastest button. Frames 0-2: the hips sit back a little and the right shoulder rolls in, the lead fist leaving the chin; 3-4: the fist snaps out level at chest height, its front 3.2 m out at about 7.2 m (the hit box follows the fist back to the wrist: x 1.7-3.2, y 6.6-7.8, so it hits a crouching mech); 5-16: it snaps back to the chin. The torso turns 10 degrees into it, the left fist stays at the jaw, the wings stay folded. A straight arm is 6.3 m from the shoulder to the knuckles and would reach 6 m: to keep the reach phase 1 measured (3.2 m), the jab is a short punch from the ribs, the elbow tucked in and the forearm and fist level. The hand and fist are not hurtable from the first active frame until 10 frames after the last (3-14): the arm is hurtable to the wrist, about 2.4 m out. Feet planted.
